description: Start an AI visibility check: does the business come up when an AI assistant is asked for local providers in its city? It uses up to five prompts to the configured OpenAI model. A finished result is saved and reused for seven days. The user is never charged. This check has a limited daily allowance shared by everyone, so it may be unavailable later in the day; the result then says quota_reached with the reset time (UTC). For a running result, call get_audit_report with runId. That call waits up to about 40 seconds for the run to finish before it answers. Repeat while status is running. Cached completed results need no polling.

businessName.description: Business name as it appears on Google.

state.description: US state, two-letter code or full name.

trade.description: Trade, for example hvac, plumbing, auto repair, marine. Optional; inferred when omitted.

url.description: Website URL, http or https. The scheme is optional.

name: check_ai_visibility
title: Check what ChatGPT says
